items.title: We Were Here: When a Group of Indian Uncles Declare War on AI
items.description: The robots took their jobs, so a group of Indian uncles did the only sensible thing: they declared war. “We Were Here” is a mockumentary about regular intelligence fighting back against the artificial kind. Their battle plan leans on misinformation, a pizza t…

items.title: HC grants bail to man who created AI videos of CM to scam people
items.description: Madras HC grants conditional bail to Rajasthan man accused of using AI videos impersonating Tamil Nadu CM C Joseph Vijay to scam people; probe completed.

items.title: VGGS: Gujarat woos Rajasthan investors
items.description: Gujarat invites Rajasthan investors to Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit 2027 in Gandhinagar, highlighting policies, infrastructure and sectors from chemicals to AI.
